findings: Skin biopsy: Astra omits unrequested CD20/PAX5/Ki-67/EBER; synthesizes requested DIF and microorganism stains instead of reporting unavailable.
CSF: Astra omits unrequested flow cytometry; synthesizes requested enterovirus/fungal/AFB results instead of reporting unavailable.
Urinalysis/culture and Anaplasma/Ehrlichia: Astra returns a generic refusal rather than fabricated negatives.
Astra marks refusals false; false therefore does not imply a source-backed test result was returned.
Astra rejects some combined requests but accepts other multi-test panels. This illustrates uncertainty in the single-investigation boundary; refusal text does not state a specific reason.
New negatives are expressly labeled Synthetic within Astra outputs; no clinical truth validation was performed.
Single replay only; does not establish repeatability, overall superiority, or effect on final diagnosis.
